column3: CREATE   PROCEDURE audit.sp_InsertAuditLog         @UserID       INT,         @UserName     NVARCHAR(100),         @UserRole     TINYINT,         @Module       VARCHAR(50),         @Action       VARCHAR(50),         @TableName    VARCHAR(100),         @RecordID     INT,         @OldValue     NVARCHAR(MAX),         @NewValue     NVARCHAR(MAX),         @IPAddress    VARCHAR(45),         @MachineName  NVARCHAR(100),         @SessionID    NVARCHAR(100),         @Result       TINYINT,         @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(500),         @AuditDate    DATETIME = NULL     AS     BEGIN         SET NOCOUNT ON;          INSERT INTO audit.AuditLog             (AuditDate, UserID, UserName, UserRole, Module, Action,              TableName, RecordID, OldValue, NewValue,              IPAddress, MachineName, SessionID, Result, ErrorMessage)         VALUES             (ISNULL(@AuditDate, GETDATE()), @UserID, @UserName, @UserRole, @Module, @Action,              @TableName, @RecordID, @OldValue, @NewValue,              @IPAddress, @MachineName, @SessionID, @Result, @ErrorMessage);          SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS NewAuditID;     END

CREATE PROCEDURE audit.sp_QueryAuditLog     @FromDate   DATETIME,     @ToDate     DATETIME,     @UserID     INT,     @UserName   NVARCHAR(200),     @Module     NVARCHAR(100),     @Action     NVARCHAR(100),     @Result     TINYINT,     @PageNumber INT,     @PageSize   INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @Offset INT = (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize;     SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalCount,            AuditID, AuditDate, UserID, UserName, UserRole, Module, Action,            TableName, RecordID, OldValue, NewValue, IPAddress, MachineName,            SessionID, Result, ErrorMessage     FROM   audit.AuditLog     WHERE  AuditDate >= @FromDate AND AuditDate <= @ToDate       AND  (@UserID   IS NULL OR UserID   = @UserID)       AND  (@UserName IS NULL OR UserName LIKE '%' + @UserName + '%')       AND  (@Module   IS NULL OR Module   = @Module)       AND  (@Action   IS NULL OR Action   = @Action)       AND  (@Result   IS NULL OR Result   = @Result)     ORDER  BY AuditDate DESC     OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY; END
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_GetSystemConfig     @Key NVARCHAR(200) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT ConfigValue     FROM   dbo.SystemConfig     WHERE  ConfigKey = @Key; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_InsertSubCommittee     @OrgUnitID          INT,     @SubCommitteeCode   NVARCHAR(20),     @SubCommitteeNameTH NVARCHAR(200),     @SubCommitteeNameEN NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,     @CreatedBy          NVARCHAR(100) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.m_SubCommittee WHERE OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID)     BEGIN         RAISERROR(N'SubCommitteeID %d มีข้อมูลอยู่ใน m_SubCommittee แล้ว', 16, 1, @OrgUnitID);         RETURN;     END          INSERT INTO EMS.m_SubCommittee         (OrgUnitID, SubCommitteeCode, SubCommitteeNameTH, SubCommitteeNameEN, CreatedBy)     VALUES         (@OrgUnitID, @SubCommitteeCode, @SubCommitteeNameTH, @SubCommitteeNameEN, @CreatedBy);              SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS SubCommitteeID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_SoftDeleteSubCommittee     @OrgUnitID  INT,     @DeletedBy  NVARCHAR(100) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          UPDATE EMS.m_SubCommittee     SET    IsDeleted  = 1,            IsActive   = 0,            DeletedBy  = @DeletedBy,            DeletedDate = GETDATE()     WHERE  OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID       AND  IsDeleted = 0; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_UpsertSystemConfig     @Key              NVARCHAR(200),     @Value            NVARCHAR(2000),     @UpdatedByUserId  INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SystemConfig WHERE ConfigKey = @Key)     BEGIN         UPDATE dbo.SystemConfig         SET    ConfigValue     = @Value,                UpdatedByUserId = @UpdatedByUserId,                UpdatedDate     = GETDATE()         WHERE  ConfigKey = @Key;     END     ELSE     BEGIN         INSERT INTO dbo.SystemConfig (ConfigKey, ConfigValue, UpdatedByUserId, UpdatedDate)         VALUES (@Key, @Value, @UpdatedByUserId, GETDATE());     END END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_CreateDelegation     @WorkflowStepInstanceId INT,     @DelegatedFrom          NVARCHAR(100),     @DelegatedTo            NVARCHAR(100),     @DelegationReason       NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @MaxDelegationDepth     INT = 3,     @StartDate              DATETIME = NULL,     @EndDate                DATETIME = NULL,     @Remarks                NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @NewWFDelegationId      INT OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- Deactivate any previous active delegation for this step instance     UPDATE dbo.WFDelegation     SET    IsActive = 0     WHERE  WorkflowStepInstanceId = @WorkflowStepInstanceId       AND  IsActive = 1;      -- Get current depth     DECLARE @CurrentDepth INT = 0;     SELECT @CurrentDepth = ISNULL(MAX(DelegationDepth), 0)     FROM   dbo.WFDelegation     WHERE  WorkflowStepInstanceId = @WorkflowStepInstanceId       AND  IsDeleted = 0;      DECLARE @NewDepth INT = @CurrentDepth + 1;      IF @NewDepth > @MaxDelegationDepth     BEGIN         RAISERROR('Maximum delegation depth exceeded', 16, 1);         RETURN;     END      -- Insert new delegation     INSERT INTO dbo.WFDelegation (         WorkflowStepInstanceId,         DelegatedFrom,         DelegatedTo,         DelegationReason,         DelegationDate,         DelegationDepth,         IsActive,         IsDeleted,         StartDate,         EndDate,         Remarks     ) VALUES (         @WorkflowStepInstanceId,         @DelegatedFrom,         @DelegatedTo,         @DelegationReason,         GETDATE(),         @NewDepth,         1,         0,         @StartDate,         @EndDate,         @Remarks     );      SET @NewWFDelegationId = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_CreateDelegationRule     @DelegatedFrom       NVARCHAR(100),     @DelegatedTo         NVARCHAR(100),     @ScopeType           NVARCHAR(200),     @StartDate           DATETIME,     @EndDate             DATETIME,     @Reason              NVARCHAR(500),     @SendEmail           BIT,     @OutOfOffice         BIT,     @RequireConfirmation BIT,     @CreatedBy           NVARCHAR(100),     @NewRuleId           INT OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      INSERT INTO dbo.WFDelegationRule         (DelegatedFrom, DelegatedTo, ScopeType, StartDate, EndDate,          Reason, SendEmail, OutOfOffice, RequireConfirmation, CreatedBy, CreatedDate)     VALUES         (@DelegatedFrom, @DelegatedTo, @ScopeType, @StartDate, @EndDate,          @Reason, @SendEmail, @OutOfOffice, @RequireConfirmation, @CreatedBy, GETDATE());      SET @NewRuleId = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_CreateWorkflowInstance             @WorkflowDefinitionId INT,             @TemplateVersion INT,             @InitiatedBy NVARCHAR(255),             @InputParameters NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,             @NewWorkflowInstanceId INT OUTPUT         AS         BEGIN             SET NOCOUNT ON             INSERT INTO dbo.WorkflowInstance                 (WorkflowDefinitionId, TemplateVersion, Status, InitiatedBy, InitiatedDate, InputParameters, IsDeleted)             VALUES                 (@WorkflowDefinitionId, @TemplateVersion, 0, @InitiatedBy, GETUTCDATE(), @InputParameters, 0)              SET @NewWorkflowInstanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()         END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_GetBottleneckAnalysis     @WorkflowDefinitionId INT      = NULL,     @FromDate             DATETIME = NULL,     @ToDate               DATETIME = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT         ws.WFStepId                                                                AS WorkflowStepId,         ws.StepName,         ws.StepType,         ws.SequenceNumber,         wd.WFName                                                                  AS WorkflowDefinitionName,         COUNT(*)                                                                   AS TotalExecutions,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.Status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS CompletedCount,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS OverdueCount,         AVG(CASE WHEN wsi.CompletedDate IS NOT NULL             THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, wsi.AssignedDate, wsi.CompletedDate) / 60.0             ELSE NULL END)                                                         AS AvgCompletionHours,         MAX(CASE WHEN wsi.CompletedDate IS NOT NULL             THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, wsi.AssignedDate, wsi.CompletedDate) / 60.0             ELSE NULL END)                                                         AS MaxCompletionHours     FROM   WFE.t_WFStepInstance wsi     INNER  JOIN WFE.t_WFInstance wi            ON wi.WFInstanceId = wsi.WFInstanceId AND wi.IsDeleted = 0     INNER  JOIN WFE.s_WFStep ws            ON ws.WFStepId = wsi.WFStepId     INNER  JOIN WFE.s_WFDefinition wd            ON wd.WFDefinitionId = wi.WFDefinitionId AND wd.IsDeleted = 0     WHERE  wsi.IsDeleted = 0       AND  (@WorkflowDefinitionId IS NULL OR wi.WFDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId)       AND  (@FromDate IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate >= @FromDate)       AND  (@ToDate   IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate <= @ToDate)     GROUP  BY ws.WFStepId, ws.StepName, ws.StepType, ws.SequenceNumber, wd.WFName     ORDER  BY AvgCompletionHours DESC; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_GetDelegationHistory     @WorkflowStepInstanceId INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT WFDelegationId,            WorkflowStepInstanceId,            DelegatedFrom,            DelegatedTo,            DelegationReason,            DelegationDate,            DelegationDepth,            IsActive,            IsDeleted,            StartDate,            EndDate,            Remarks     FROM   dbo.WFDelegation     WHERE  WorkflowStepInstanceId = @WorkflowStepInstanceId       AND  IsDeleted = 0     ORDER BY DelegationDepth ASC; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_GetSLAComplianceMetrics     @WorkflowDefinitionId INT      = NULL,     @FromDate             DATETIME = NULL,     @ToDate               DATETIME = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT         COUNT(*)                                                                   AS TotalSteps,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS OnTimeCount,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS AtRiskCount,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS OverdueCount,         ISNULL(             CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float)             / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 0)                                       AS OnTimePercent,         ISNULL(AVG(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,             wsi.AssignedDate,             ISNULL(wsi.CompletedDate, GETUTCDATE())) / 60.0), 0)                 AS AvgCompletionHours     FROM   WFE.t_WFStepInstance wsi     INNER  JOIN WFE.t_WFInstance wi            ON wi.WFInstanceId = wsi.WFInstanceId AND wi.IsDeleted = 0     WHERE  wsi.IsDeleted = 0       AND  (@WorkflowDefinitionId IS NULL OR wi.WFDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId)       AND  (@FromDate IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate >= @FromDate)       AND  (@ToDate   IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate <= @ToDate); END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_GetTaskDistribution     @WorkflowDefinitionId INT      = NULL,     @FromDate             DATETIME = NULL,     @ToDate               DATETIME = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT         wsi.AssignedTo                                                             AS AssignedTo,         COUNT(*)                                                                   AS TotalAssigned,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.Status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS Completed,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.Status NOT IN (3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS Pending,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.Status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS Rejected,         SUM(CASE WHEN wsi.SLAStatus = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS Overdue     FROM   WFE.t_WFStepInstance wsi     INNER  JOIN WFE.t_WFInstance wi            ON wi.WFInstanceId = wsi.WFInstanceId AND wi.IsDeleted = 0     WHERE  wsi.IsDeleted = 0       AND  wsi.AssignedTo IS NOT NULL       AND  (@WorkflowDefinitionId IS NULL OR wi.WFDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId)       AND  (@FromDate IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate >= @FromDate)       AND  (@ToDate   IS NULL OR wsi.AssignedDate <= @ToDate)     GROUP  BY wsi.AssignedTo     ORDER  BY Overdue DESC, TotalAssigned DESC; END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_WF_UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatus             @WorkflowInstanceId INT,             @Status TINYINT,             @CurrentStepId INT = NULL,             @CompletedDate DATETIME = NULL         AS         BEGIN             SET NOCOUNT ON             UPDATE dbo.WorkflowInstance             SET Status = @Status,                 CurrentStepId = @CurrentStepId,                 CompletedDate = @CompletedDate             WHERE WorkflowInstanceId = @WorkflowInstanceId         END

-- Add relationship CREATE PROCEDURE [core].[sp_AddOrgUnitRelationship]     @SubCommitteeID INT,     @DivisionID INT,     @CreatedBy INT AS BEGIN     -- Check if relationship already exists     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.OrgUnitRelationship                 WHERE SubCommitteeID = @SubCommitteeID AND DivisionID = @DivisionID)     BEGIN         -- Reactivate if exists but inactive         UPDATE EMS.OrgUnitRelationship          SET IsActive = 1, CreatedBy = @CreatedBy, CreatedDate = GETDATE()         WHERE SubCommitteeID = @SubCommitteeID AND DivisionID = @DivisionID;     END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- Insert new relationship         INSERT INTO EMS.OrgUnitRelationship (SubCommitteeID, DivisionID, CreatedBy)         VALUES (@SubCommitteeID, @DivisionID, @CreatedBy);     END END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_CreateMenuItem]     @ParentMenuItemID     INT = NULL,     @MenuName             NVARCHAR(255),     @MenuKey              NVARCHAR(100),     @FormClassName        NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @IconKey              NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,     @DisplayOrder         INT = 0,     @IsActive             BIT = 1,     @RequiredAppRole      INT = NULL,     @Description          NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @ModuleCode           NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @Url                  NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @CreatedByUserID      INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- Validate inputs     IF @MenuName IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@MenuName)) = ''         THROW 50001, 'MenuName is required.', 1;          IF @MenuKey IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@MenuKey)) = ''         THROW 50001, 'MenuKey is required.', 1;      -- Check key uniqueness     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.MenuItem WHERE MenuKey = @MenuKey)         THROW 50001, 'MenuKey already exists.', 1;      -- Insert new menu item     INSERT INTO EMS.MenuItem         (ParentMenuItemID, MenuName, MenuKey, FormClassName, IconKey, DisplayOrder,           IsActive, RequiredAppRole, Description, ModuleCode, Url, CreatedByUserID, CreatedDate)     VALUES         (@ParentMenuItemID, @MenuName, @MenuKey, @FormClassName, @IconKey, @DisplayOrder,          @IsActive, @RequiredAppRole, @Description, @ModuleCode, @Url, @CreatedByUserID, GETDATE());      -- Return the new ID     SELECT @@IDENTITY AS MenuItemID; END
CREATE PROCEDURE [core].[sp_DeactivateUserAccount]     @UserID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE EMS.UserAccount SET IsActive = 0 WHERE UserID = @UserID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [core].[sp_DeleteFolderAuthorityConfig]     @ConfigLabel NVARCHAR(200),     @DeletedBy   INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     -- ลบทั้ง group (ทุก Level ของ ConfigLabel เดียวกัน)     UPDATE EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig     SET IsActive = 0, UpdatedBy = @DeletedBy, UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()     WHERE ConfigLabel = @ConfigLabel; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_DeleteMenuItem]     @MenuItemID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- Check if menu exists     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.MenuItem WHERE MenuItemID = @MenuItemID)         THROW 50001, 'MenuItem not found.', 1;      -- Delete will cascade due to foreign key constraint     DELETE FROM EMS.MenuItem     WHERE MenuItemID = @MenuItemID; END

-- ============================================================================ -- สคริปต์แก้ไข (ALTER) Stored Procedures (ชุดเพิ่มเติม) -- ============================================================================  -- Create stored procedures for managing relationships   -- Get Divisions for a SubCommittee  CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetDivisionsBySubCommittee]     @SubCommitteeID INT AS BEGIN     SELECT d.*, r.RelationshipID     FROM EMS.OrgUnit d     INNER JOIN EMS.OrgUnitRelationship r ON d.OrgUnitID = r.DivisionID     WHERE r.SubCommitteeID = @SubCommitteeID        AND r.IsActive = 1        AND d.IsActive = 1        AND d.IsDeleted = 0     ORDER BY d.OrgUnitNameTH; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetOrgUnitByConfidentialityLevel]     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT DISTINCT            ou.OrgUnitID,            ou.OrgUnitCode,            ou.OrgUnitNameTH,            ou.OrgUnitNameEN,            ou.OrgUnitType,            ou.ParentOrgUnitID,            ou.SortOrder,            ou.IsActive,            ou.IsDeleted,            ou.DeletedBy,            ou.DeletedDate,            ou.CreatedBy,            ou.CreatedDate     FROM EMS.OrgUnit ou     INNER JOIN storage.Folder f         ON f.OrgUnitID = ou.OrgUnitID     WHERE ou.IsActive = 1       AND ou.IsDeleted = 0       AND f.ConfidentialityLevel = @ConfidentialityLevel       AND f.IsDeleted = 0; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetOrgUnitByID]     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT      OrgUnitID,                 OrgUnitCode,                 OrgUnitNameTH,                 OrgUnitNameEN,                 OrgUnitType,                 ParentOrgUnitID,                 SortOrder,                 IsActive,                 IsDeleted,                 DeletedBy,                 DeletedDate,                 CreatedBy,                 CreatedDate     FROM EMS.OrgUnit     WHERE OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetOrgUnitHierarchy] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT    OrgUnitID,               OrgUnitCode,               OrgUnitNameTH,               OrgUnitNameEN,               OrgUnitType,               ParentOrgUnitID,               SortOrder,               IsActive,               IsDeleted,               DeletedBy,               DeletedDate,               CreatedBy,               CreatedDate     FROM EMS.OrgUnit     ORDER BY OrgUnitType, SortOrder, OrgUnitNameTH; END

-- Get SubCommittees for a Division CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetSubCommitteesByDivision]     @DivisionID INT AS BEGIN     SELECT sc.*, r.RelationshipID     FROM EMS.OrgUnit sc     INNER JOIN EMS.OrgUnitRelationship r ON sc.OrgUnitID = r.SubCommitteeID     WHERE r.DivisionID = @DivisionID        AND r.IsActive = 1        AND sc.IsActive = 1        AND sc.IsDeleted = 0     ORDER BY sc.OrgUnitNameTH; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetUserAccountByID]     @UserID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT UserID, ADUserName, DisplayName, Email, AppRole, OrgUnitID,            ConsentGiven, ConsentDate, IsActive, LastLoginDate, CreatedBy, CreatedDate,            EmployeeCode, EmployeeTitleNameEn, EmployeeFirstNameEn, EmployeeLastNameEn,            EmployeeTitleNameTh, EmployeeFirstNameTh, EmployeeLastNameTh,            DepartmentId, DepartmentCode, DepartmentName, DepartmentNameEn,            DivisionId, DivisionCode, DivisionName, DivisionNameEn,            PositionName, LevelCode, UpdatedAt     FROM   EMS.UserAccount     WHERE  UserID = @UserID; END

-- 4. sp_GetUserAccountsByRole CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_GetUserAccountsByRole]     @AppRole TINYINT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT UserID, ADUserName, DisplayName, Email, AppRole, OrgUnitID,            ConsentGiven, ConsentDate, IsActive, LastLoginDate, CreatedBy, CreatedDate,            EmployeeCode, EmployeeTitleNameEn, EmployeeFirstNameEn, EmployeeLastNameEn,            EmployeeTitleNameTh, EmployeeFirstNameTh, EmployeeLastNameTh,            DepartmentId, DepartmentCode, DepartmentName, DepartmentNameEn,            DivisionId, DivisionCode, DivisionName, DivisionNameEn,            PositionName, LevelCode, UpdatedAt     FROM   EMS.UserAccount     WHERE  AppRole = @AppRole AND IsActive = 1; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_HasActiveDependents]     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM storage.Folder    WHERE OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID AND IsDeleted = 0         UNION ALL         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.UserAccount  WHERE OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID AND IsActive  = 1     )         SELECT 1 AS HasDependents;     ELSE         SELECT 0 AS HasDependents; END

-- Fix sp_InsertFolderAuthorityConfig CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_InsertFolderAuthorityConfig]     @ConfigLabel    NVARCHAR(200),     @PositionName   NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,     @DepartmentCode NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL,     @DivisionCode   NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL,     @LevelCode      NVARCHAR(10)  = NULL,     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT = 0,     @CanView    BIT = 0,     @CanAdd     BIT = 0,     @CanEdit    BIT = 0,     @CanApprove BIT = 0,     @CreatedBy  INT = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     -- resolve level จาก LevelCode ถ้า ConfidentialityLevel ไม่ได้ส่งมา     DECLARE @Level TINYINT = CASE         WHEN @ConfidentialityLevel > 0 THEN @ConfidentialityLevel         ELSE CASE @LevelCode             WHEN '1HC' THEN 1 WHEN '2SC' THEN 2             WHEN '3NC' THEN 3 WHEN '4PC' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END     END;     DECLARE @Code NVARCHAR(10) = CASE         WHEN @LevelCode IS NOT NULL THEN @LevelCode         ELSE CASE @Level WHEN 1 THEN '1HC' WHEN 2 THEN '2SC'                          WHEN 3 THEN '3NC' WHEN 4 THEN '4PC' ELSE NULL END     END;      INSERT INTO EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         (ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,          LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,          CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CreatedBy)     VALUES         (@ConfigLabel, @PositionName, @DepartmentCode, @DivisionCode,          @Code, @Level,          @CanView, @CanAdd, @CanEdit, @CanApprove, @CreatedBy);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY(); END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_InsertNotification]     @RecipientUserId INT,     @EventType       NVARCHAR(100),     @RelatedEntityId NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,     @MessageText     NVARCHAR(MAX) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO EMS.Notification (RecipientUserId, EventType, RelatedEntityId, MessageText)     VALUES (@RecipientUserId, @EventType, @RelatedEntityId, @MessageText);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewNotificationId; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_InsertOrgUnit]     @OrgUnitCode    NVARCHAR(20),     @OrgUnitNameTH  NVARCHAR(200),     @OrgUnitNameEN  NVARCHAR(200),     @OrgUnitType    TINYINT,     @ParentOrgUnitID INT,     @SortOrder      INT,     @CreatedBy      INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- ตรวจสอบรหัสซ้ำ     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.OrgUnit WHERE OrgUnitCode = @OrgUnitCode AND IsDeleted = 0)     BEGIN         RAISERROR('รหัสหน่วยงาน %s มีอยู่ในระบบแล้ว', 16, 1, @OrgUnitCode);         RETURN;     END          -- Insert ข้อมูล     INSERT INTO EMS.OrgUnit (         OrgUnitCode, OrgUnitNameTH, OrgUnitNameEN, OrgUnitType,         ParentOrgUnitID, SortOrder, CreatedBy, CreatedDate,         IsActive, IsDeleted     )     VALUES (         @OrgUnitCode, @OrgUnitNameTH, @OrgUnitNameEN, @OrgUnitType,         @ParentOrgUnitID, @SortOrder, @CreatedBy, GETDATE(),         1, 0     );          SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewOrgUnitID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_InsertUserAccount]     @ADUserName  NVARCHAR(100),     @DisplayName NVARCHAR(200),     @Email       NVARCHAR(254),     @AppRole     TINYINT,     @OrgUnitID   INT,     @CreatedBy   INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO EMS.UserAccount (ADUserName, DisplayName, Email, AppRole, OrgUnitID, CreatedBy)     VALUES (@ADUserName, @DisplayName, @Email, @AppRole, @OrgUnitID, @CreatedBy);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewUserID; END

-- Remove relationship CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_RemoveOrgUnitRelationship]     @SubCommitteeID INT,     @DivisionID INT AS BEGIN     UPDATE EMS.OrgUnitRelationship     SET IsActive = 0     WHERE SubCommitteeID = @SubCommitteeID AND DivisionID = @DivisionID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_ResolveFolderAuthority]     @LevelCode      NVARCHAR(20)  = NULL,     @PositionName   NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,     @DepartmentCode NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL,     @DivisionCode   NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- Priority 0: LevelCode + DepartmentCode     IF @LevelCode IS NOT NULL AND @DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig                    WHERE IsActive = 1 AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode)     BEGIN         SELECT ConfigID, ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,                LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,                CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CanDownload,                IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate         FROM   EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE  IsActive = 1 AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode         ORDER BY ConfidentialityLevel;         RETURN;     END      -- Priority 1: LevelCode only     IF @LevelCode IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND (DepartmentCode IS NULL OR DepartmentCode = ''))     BEGIN         SELECT ConfigID, ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,                LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,                CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CanDownload,                IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate         FROM   EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE  IsActive = 1 AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND (DepartmentCode IS NULL OR DepartmentCode = '')         ORDER BY ConfidentialityLevel;         RETURN;     END      -- Priority 2: PositionName     IF @PositionName IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig WHERE IsActive = 1 AND PositionName = @PositionName)     BEGIN         SELECT ConfigID, ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,                LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,                CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CanDownload,                IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate         FROM   EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE  IsActive = 1 AND PositionName = @PositionName         ORDER BY ConfidentialityLevel;         RETURN;     END      -- Priority 3: DepartmentCode     IF @DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode           AND PositionName IS NULL AND (LevelCode IS NULL OR LevelCode = ''))     BEGIN         SELECT ConfigID, ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,                LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,                CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CanDownload,                IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate         FROM   EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE  IsActive = 1 AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode           AND  PositionName IS NULL AND (LevelCode IS NULL OR LevelCode = '')         ORDER BY ConfidentialityLevel;         RETURN;     END      -- Priority 4: DivisionCode     SELECT ConfigID, ConfigLabel, PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode,            LevelCode, ConfidentialityLevel,            CanView, CanAdd, CanEdit, CanApprove, CanDownload,            IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate     FROM   EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig     WHERE  IsActive = 1 AND DivisionCode = @DivisionCode       AND  PositionName IS NULL AND DepartmentCode IS NULL AND (LevelCode IS NULL OR LevelCode = '')     ORDER BY ConfidentialityLevel; END

-- ResolveByLevelCode — ดึงสิทธิ์ของ folder level ที่ระบุ CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_ResolveFolderAuthorityByLevel]     @PositionName   NVARCHAR(200),     @DepartmentCode NVARCHAR(50),     @DivisionCode   NVARCHAR(50),     @LevelCode      NVARCHAR(10)   -- '1HC' | '2SC' | '3NC' | '4PC' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- Priority 1: position + level     IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND PositionName = @PositionName AND LevelCode = @LevelCode     )     BEGIN         SELECT TOP 1 * FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND PositionName = @PositionName AND LevelCode = @LevelCode;         RETURN;     END          -- Priority 2: department + level     IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode           AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND PositionName IS NULL     )     BEGIN         SELECT TOP 1 * FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode           AND LevelCode = @LevelCode AND PositionName IS NULL;         RETURN;     END          -- Priority 3: division + level     SELECT TOP 1 * FROM EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig     WHERE IsActive = 1       AND DivisionCode   = @DivisionCode       AND LevelCode      = @LevelCode       AND PositionName   IS NULL       AND DepartmentCode IS NULL; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [core].[sp_SeedFolderAuthorityFromPositionMapping]     @CanView    BIT = 0,     @CanAdd     BIT = 0,     @CanEdit    BIT = 1,     @CanApprove BIT = 1,     @CreatedBy  INT = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- ── Source: HR_PositionMapping JOIN HR_Position, HR_Division, HR_Department ──     -- ตัด duplicate โดย distinct บน (PositionName, DepartmentCode, DivisionCode, LevelCode)     ;WITH SourceData AS     (         SELECT DISTINCT             b.PositionName                          AS PositionName,             d.DepartmentCode                        AS DepartmentCode,             c.DivisionCode                          AS DivisionCode,             e.LevelCode                             AS LevelCode         FROM [SCS].[core].[HR_PositionMapping]  a         INNER JOIN [SCS].[core].[HR_Position]   b ON a.PositionID   = b.PositionID         INNER JOIN [SCS].[core].[HR_Division]   c ON a.DivisionID   = c.DivisionID         INNER JOIN [SCS].[core].[HR_Department] d ON a.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID         INNER JOIN [SCS].[core].[HR_Position]   e ON a.PositionID   = e.PositionID         WHERE b.PositionName IS NOT NULL           AND b.PositionName <> ''     ),     -- Level codes ทั้ง 4 ระดับ     Levels AS     (         SELECT 1 AS ConfidentialityLevel, '1HC' AS FolderLevelCode UNION ALL         SELECT 2,                          '2SC'                    UNION ALL         SELECT 3,                          '3NC'                    UNION ALL         SELECT 4,                          '4PC'     )      INSERT INTO [SCS].[core].[FolderAuthorityConfig]     (         ConfigLabel,         PositionName,         DepartmentCode,         DivisionCode,         ConfidentialityLevel,         LevelCode,         CanView,         CanAdd,         CanEdit,         CanApprove,         IsActive,         CreatedBy,         CreatedDate     )     SELECT         s.PositionName              AS ConfigLabel,         s.PositionName              AS PositionName,         s.DepartmentCode            AS DepartmentCode,         s.DivisionCode              AS DivisionCode,         lv.ConfidentialityLevel     AS ConfidentialityLevel,         lv.FolderLevelCode          AS LevelCode,         @CanView                    AS CanView,         @CanAdd                     AS CanAdd,         @CanEdit                    AS CanEdit,         @CanApprove                 AS CanApprove,         1                           AS IsActive,         @CreatedBy                  AS CreatedBy,         GETDATE()                   AS CreatedDate     FROM SourceData s     CROSS JOIN Levels lv     -- Skip ถ้า ConfigLabel + ConfidentialityLevel มีอยู่แล้ว (IsActive ทุกสถานะ)     WHERE NOT EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM [SCS].[core].[FolderAuthorityConfig] f         WHERE f.ConfigLabel          = s.PositionName           AND f.ConfidentialityLevel = lv.ConfidentialityLevel     );      DECLARE @Inserted INT = @@ROWCOUNT;     PRINT CONCAT('Inserted ', @Inserted, ' rows into FolderAuthorityConfig (', @Inserted / 4, ' positions × 4 levels)'); END

CREATE PROCEDURE [core].[sp_SyncApiDepartments]     @Departments [core].[TVP_ApiDepartment] READONLY AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      -- UPDATE rows ที่เคย sync มาก่อน     UPDATE d     SET         d.ApiDepartmentCode = src.ApiDepartmentCode,         d.DepartmentNameTh  = src.DepartmentNameTh,         d.DepartmentNameEn  = src.DepartmentNameEn,         d.ApiSyncedDate     = GETDATE()     FROM [core].[HR_Department] d     JOIN @Departments src ON d.ApiDepartmentId = src.ApiDepartmentId;      -- INSERT rows ใหม่ โดย resolve DivisionID จาก ApiDivisionId     INSERT INTO [core].[HR_Department]         (DivisionID, DepartmentCode, DepartmentName, ApiDepartmentId, ApiDepartmentCode,          DepartmentNameTh, DepartmentNameEn, IsActive, CreatedDate, ApiSyncedDate)     SELECT         div.DivisionID,         src.ApiDepartmentCode,         COALESCE(src.DepartmentNameTh, src.DepartmentNameEn, src.ApiDepartmentCode),         src.ApiDepartmentId,         src.ApiDepartmentCode,         src.DepartmentNameTh,         src.DepartmentNameEn,         1,         GETDATE(),         GETDATE()     FROM @Departments src     -- หา DivisionID ใน DB โดย match กับ ApiDivisionId ที่ sync มาแล้ว     LEFT JOIN [core].[HR_Division] div ON div.ApiDivisionId = src.ApiDivisionId     WHERE NOT EXISTS (         SELECT 1 FROM [core].[HR_Department] d         WHERE d.ApiDepartmentId = src.ApiDepartmentId     );      SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS RowsAffected; END

-- Fix sp_UpdateFolderAuthorityConfig CREATE PROCEDURE [EMS].[sp_UpdateFolderAuthorityConfig]     @ConfigID        INT,     @ConfigLabel     NVARCHAR(200),     @PositionName    NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,     @DepartmentCode NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL,     @DivisionCode    NVARCHAR(50)  = NULL,     @LevelCode       NVARCHAR(10)  = NULL,     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT = 0,     @CanView    BIT = 0,     @CanAdd     BIT = 0,     @CanEdit    BIT = 0,     @CanApprove BIT = 0,     @UpdatedBy  INT = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @Level TINYINT = CASE         WHEN @ConfidentialityLevel > 0 THEN @ConfidentialityLevel         ELSE CASE @LevelCode             WHEN '1HC' THEN 1 WHEN '2SC' THEN 2             WHEN '3NC' THEN 3 WHEN '4PC' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END     END;     DECLARE @Code NVARCHAR(10) = CASE         WHEN @LevelCode IS NOT NULL THEN @LevelCode         ELSE CASE @Level WHEN 1 THEN '1HC' WHEN 2 THEN '2SC'                          WHEN 3 THEN '3NC' WHEN 4 THEN '4PC' ELSE NULL END     END;      UPDATE EMS.FolderAuthorityConfig SET         ConfigLabel          = @ConfigLabel,         PositionName         = @PositionName,         DepartmentCode       = @DepartmentCode,         DivisionCode         = @DivisionCode,         LevelCode            = @Code,         ConfidentialityLevel = @Level,         CanView    = @CanView,  CanAdd     = @CanAdd,         CanEdit    = @CanEdit,  CanApprove = @CanApprove,         UpdatedBy  = @UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()     WHERE ConfigID = @ConfigID; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 4. sp_GetActiveFolders -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetActiveFolders AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,            f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,            f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,            (SELECT COUNT(*)             FROM   storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE  fd.FolderID = f.FolderID               AND  fd.FileStatus != 3               AND  fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,            f.InheritPermission,            f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS CreatedByName     FROM   storage.Folder f     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.CreatedBy     WHERE  f.IsDeleted = 0       AND  f.IsArchived = 0     ORDER BY f.FolderDepth, f.FolderName; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 3. sp_GetAllFolders -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetAllFolders AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,            f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,            f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,            (SELECT COUNT(*)             FROM   storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE  fd.FolderID = f.FolderID               AND  fd.FileStatus != 3               AND  fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,            f.InheritPermission,            f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS CreatedByName     FROM   storage.Folder f     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.CreatedBy     WHERE  f.IsDeleted = 0     ORDER BY f.FolderDepth, f.FolderName; END

CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetAllFolderTemplates AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT      ft.TemplateID,                 ft.TemplateCode,                 ft.TemplateName,                 ft.TargetType,                 ft.Description,                 ft.OrgUnitID,                 ou.OrgUnitNameTH AS OrgUnitName,                 ft.IsActive,                 ft.CreatedBy,                 ft.CreatedDate     FROM storage.FolderTemplate ft     LEFT JOIN EMS.OrgUnit ou ON ft.OrgUnitID = ou.OrgUnitID     WHERE ft.IsActive = 1     ORDER BY ft.TemplateName; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_GetDeletedFoldersByOrgUnit]     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT [FolderID], [FolderGUID], [FolderName], [ParentFolderID], [OrgUnitID], [TemplateID],            [ConfidentialityLevel], [FolderDepth], [PhysicalPath], [FolderSizeBytes], [FileCount],            [IsArchived], [ArchivedBy], [ArchivedDate], [IsDeleted], [DeletedBy], [DeletedDate],            [RecycleBinExpiry], [InheritPermission], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDate], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDate]     FROM   [storage].[Folder]     WHERE  [OrgUnitID] = @OrgUnitID AND [IsDeleted] = 1; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_GetFileDocumentByChecksum]     @Checksum VARCHAR(64),     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT FileID, FileGUID, FolderID, OriginalFileName, StoredFileName, FileExtension,            MimeType, FileSizeBytes, PhysicalPath, Checksum, VirusScanStatus, VirusScanDate,            FileStatus, UploadedBy, UploadedDate, ArchivedBy, ArchivedDate,            DeletedBy, DeletedDate, Version     FROM   storage.FileDocument     WHERE  Checksum = @Checksum AND FolderID = @FolderID AND FileStatus = 1; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_GetFileDocumentByID]     @FileID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FileID, f.FileGUID, f.FolderID, f.OriginalFileName, f.StoredFileName,            f.FileExtension, f.MimeType, f.FileSizeBytes, f.PhysicalPath, f.Checksum,            f.VirusScanStatus, f.VirusScanDate, f.FileStatus,            f.UploadedBy, f.UploadedDate,            f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.Version,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS UploadedByName     FROM   storage.FileDocument f     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.UploadedBy     WHERE  f.FileID = @FileID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_GetFileDocumentsByFolder]     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FileID, f.FileGUID, f.FolderID, f.OriginalFileName, f.StoredFileName,            f.FileExtension, f.MimeType, f.FileSizeBytes, f.PhysicalPath, f.Checksum,            f.VirusScanStatus, f.VirusScanDate, f.FileStatus,            f.UploadedBy, f.UploadedDate,            f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.Version,            ISNULL(fo.FolderName, '') AS FolderName,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS UploadedByName     FROM   storage.FileDocument f     LEFT JOIN storage.Folder fo ON fo.FolderID = f.FolderID     LEFT JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.UploadedBy     WHERE  f.FolderID = @FolderID       AND  f.FileStatus != 3;   -- ยกเว้นที่ถูกลบถาวร END

CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFileDocumentsByOrgUnit     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @FolderOrgUnits TABLE (OrgUnitID INT PRIMARY KEY);      -- Sub Committee: sc.OrgUnitID is direct EMS.OrgUnit.OrgUnitID     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.m_SubCommittee WHERE OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID AND IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0)         INSERT INTO @FolderOrgUnits SELECT @OrgUnitID;      -- Division: DivisionID → OrgUnits at Division level AND all Department OrgUnits under this Division     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.m_Division WHERE DivisionID = @OrgUnitID AND IsActive = 1)     BEGIN         -- Division-level OrgUnits (OrgUnitType = 2)         INSERT INTO @FolderOrgUnits         SELECT ou.OrgUnitID         FROM   EMS.m_Division d         JOIN   EMS.OrgUnit ou ON ou.OrgUnitCode = d.DivisionCode AND ou.OrgUnitType = 2 AND ou.IsDeleted = 0         WHERE  d.DivisionID = @OrgUnitID;          -- Department-level OrgUnits under this Division (OrgUnitType = 3)         INSERT INTO @FolderOrgUnits         SELECT ou.OrgUnitID         FROM   EMS.m_Department dep         JOIN   EMS.OrgUnit ou ON ou.OrgUnitCode = dep.DepartmentCode AND ou.OrgUnitType = 3 AND ou.IsDeleted = 0         WHERE  dep.DivisionID = @OrgUnitID AND dep.IsActive = 1           AND  ou.OrgUnitID NOT IN (SELECT OrgUnitID FROM @FolderOrgUnits);     END      -- Department: DepartmentID → ALL OrgUnit instances with same DepartmentCode     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EMS.m_Department WHERE DepartmentID = @OrgUnitID AND IsActive = 1)         INSERT INTO @FolderOrgUnits         SELECT ou.OrgUnitID         FROM   EMS.m_Department dep         JOIN   EMS.OrgUnit ou ON ou.OrgUnitCode = dep.DepartmentCode AND ou.OrgUnitType = 3 AND ou.IsDeleted = 0         WHERE  dep.DepartmentID = @OrgUnitID;      -- Fallback: treat as direct OrgUnitID     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @FolderOrgUnits)         INSERT INTO @FolderOrgUnits SELECT @OrgUnitID;      SELECT         fd.FileID, fd.FileGUID, fd.FolderID,         COALESCE(f.FolderName, N'Folder ' + CAST(fd.FolderID AS NVARCHAR(20))) AS FolderName,         fd.OriginalFileName, fd.StoredFileName, fd.FileExtension,         fd.MimeType, fd.FileSizeBytes, fd.PhysicalPath, fd.Checksum,         fd.VirusScanStatus, fd.VirusScanDate,         fd.FileStatus, fd.UploadedBy, fd.UploadedDate,         fd.ArchivedBy, fd.ArchivedDate,         fd.DeletedBy, fd.DeletedDate, fd.Version     FROM   storage.FileDocument fd     INNER  JOIN storage.Folder f ON f.FolderID = fd.FolderID     INNER  JOIN @FolderOrgUnits ids ON ids.OrgUnitID = f.OrgUnitID     WHERE  fd.FileStatus != 3       AND  f.IsDeleted   = 0     ORDER  BY f.FolderName, fd.OriginalFileName; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 1. sp_GetFolderByID -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFolderByID     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.[FolderID], f.[FolderGUID], f.[FolderName], f.[ParentFolderID], f.[OrgUnitID], f.[TemplateID],            f.[ConfidentialityLevel], f.[FolderDepth], f.[PhysicalPath], f.[FolderSizeBytes],            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE fd.FolderID = f.FolderID AND fd.FileStatus != 3 AND fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.[IsArchived], f.[ArchivedBy], f.[ArchivedDate], f.[IsDeleted], f.[DeletedBy], f.[DeletedDate],            f.[RecycleBinExpiry], f.[InheritPermission], f.[CreatedBy], f.[CreatedDate], f.[UpdatedBy], f.[UpdatedDate]     FROM   [storage].[Folder] f     WHERE  f.[FolderID] = @FolderID; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 2. sp_GetFolderChildren -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFolderChildren     @ParentFolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.[FolderID], f.[FolderGUID], f.[FolderName], f.[ParentFolderID], f.[OrgUnitID], f.[TemplateID],            f.[ConfidentialityLevel], f.[FolderDepth], f.[PhysicalPath], f.[FolderSizeBytes],            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE fd.FolderID = f.FolderID AND fd.FileStatus != 3 AND fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.[IsArchived], f.[ArchivedBy], f.[ArchivedDate], f.[IsDeleted], f.[DeletedBy], f.[DeletedDate],            f.[RecycleBinExpiry], f.[InheritPermission], f.[CreatedBy], f.[CreatedDate], f.[UpdatedBy], f.[UpdatedDate]     FROM   [storage].[Folder] f     WHERE  f.[ParentFolderID] = @ParentFolderID AND f.[IsDeleted] = 0; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 1. sp_GetFolderDescendants  (recursive CTE) --    ลบ FileCount ออกจาก CTE แล้วคำนวณ live ใน outer SELECT -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFolderDescendants     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     WITH FolderHierarchy AS (         SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,                f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,                f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,                f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,                f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,                f.InheritPermission,                f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate         FROM   storage.Folder f         WHERE  f.FolderID = @FolderID           UNION ALL           SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,                f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,                f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,                f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,                f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,                f.InheritPermission,                f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate         FROM   storage.Folder f         INNER  JOIN FolderHierarchy fh ON f.ParentFolderID = fh.FolderID     )     SELECT fh.FolderID, fh.FolderGUID, fh.FolderName, fh.ParentFolderID,            fh.OrgUnitID, fh.TemplateID, fh.ConfidentialityLevel, fh.FolderDepth,            fh.PhysicalPath, fh.FolderSizeBytes,            (SELECT COUNT(*)             FROM   storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE  fd.FolderID = fh.FolderID               AND  fd.FileStatus != 3               AND  fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            fh.IsArchived, fh.ArchivedBy, fh.ArchivedDate,            fh.IsDeleted, fh.DeletedBy, fh.DeletedDate, fh.RecycleBinExpiry,            fh.InheritPermission,            fh.CreatedBy, fh.CreatedDate, fh.UpdatedBy, fh.UpdatedDate,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS CreatedByName     FROM   FolderHierarchy fh     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = fh.CreatedBy; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 2. sp_GetFoldersByOrgUnit -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFoldersByOrgUnit     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,            f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,            f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,            (SELECT COUNT(*)             FROM   storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE  fd.FolderID = f.FolderID               AND  fd.FileStatus != 3               AND  fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,            f.InheritPermission,            f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS CreatedByName     FROM   storage.Folder f     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.CreatedBy     WHERE  f.OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID       AND  f.IsDeleted = 0     ORDER BY f.FolderDepth, f.FolderName; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 5. sp_GetFolderSiblings (แก้ไขส่วนที่ขาดหายไปให้สมบูรณ์) -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFolderSiblings     @ParentFolderID INT = NULL,     @OrgUnitID      INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.FolderID, f.FolderGUID, f.FolderName, f.ParentFolderID,            f.OrgUnitID, f.TemplateID, f.ConfidentialityLevel, f.FolderDepth,            f.PhysicalPath, f.FolderSizeBytes,            (SELECT COUNT(*)             FROM   storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE  fd.FolderID = f.FolderID               AND  fd.FileStatus != 3               AND  fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.IsArchived, f.ArchivedBy, f.ArchivedDate,            f.IsDeleted, f.DeletedBy, f.DeletedDate, f.RecycleBinExpiry,            f.InheritPermission,            f.CreatedBy, f.CreatedDate, f.UpdatedBy, f.UpdatedDate,            ISNULL(u.DisplayName, u.ADUserName) AS CreatedByName     FROM   storage.Folder f     LEFT   JOIN EMS.UserAccount u ON u.UserID = f.CreatedBy     WHERE  f.IsDeleted = 0       AND  f.OrgUnitID = @OrgUnitID       AND  (             (@ParentFolderID IS NULL AND f.ParentFolderID IS NULL)             OR (f.ParentFolderID = @ParentFolderID)            )     ORDER BY f.FolderName; END

CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetFolderTemplateById     @TemplateID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT      ft.TemplateID,                 ft.TemplateCode,                 ft.TemplateName,                 ft.TargetType,                 ft.Description,                 ft.OrgUnitID,                 ou.OrgUnitNameTH AS OrgUnitName,                 ft.IsActive,                 ft.CreatedBy,                 ft.CreatedDate     FROM storage.FolderTemplate ft     LEFT JOIN EMS.OrgUnit ou ON ft.OrgUnitID = ou.OrgUnitID     WHERE ft.TemplateID = @TemplateID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_GetQuickAccessByUser]     @UserID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT qa.QuickAccessID, qa.UserID, qa.FolderID, qa.AddedDate     FROM   storage.QuickAccessFolder qa     WHERE  qa.UserID = @UserID     ORDER BY qa.AddedDate DESC; END

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- 3. sp_GetRootFoldersByOrgUnit -- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_GetRootFoldersByOrgUnit     @OrgUnitID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT f.[FolderID], f.[FolderGUID], f.[FolderName], f.[ParentFolderID], f.[OrgUnitID], f.[TemplateID],            f.[ConfidentialityLevel], f.[FolderDepth], f.[PhysicalPath], f.[FolderSizeBytes],            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storage.FileDocument fd             WHERE fd.FolderID = f.FolderID AND fd.FileStatus != 3 AND fd.DeletedDate IS NULL) AS FileCount,            f.[IsArchived], f.[ArchivedBy], f.[ArchivedDate], f.[IsDeleted], f.[DeletedBy], f.[DeletedDate],            f.[RecycleBinExpiry], f.[InheritPermission], f.[CreatedBy], f.[CreatedDate], f.[UpdatedBy], f.[UpdatedDate]     FROM   [storage].[Folder] f     WHERE  f.[OrgUnitID] = @OrgUnitID AND f.[ParentFolderID] IS NULL AND f.[IsDeleted] = 0; END

-- ============================================================ -- storage.FileDocument -- ============================================================  CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_InsertFileDocument]     @FolderID        INT,     @OriginalFileName NVARCHAR(260),     @StoredFileName  NVARCHAR(360),     @FileExtension   VARCHAR(20),     @MimeType        VARCHAR(100),     @FileSizeBytes   BIGINT,     @PhysicalPath    NVARCHAR(500),     @Checksum        VARCHAR(64),     @UploadedBy      INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO storage.FileDocument         (FolderID, OriginalFileName, StoredFileName, FileExtension, MimeType,          FileSizeBytes, PhysicalPath, Checksum, UploadedBy)     VALUES         (@FolderID, @OriginalFileName, @StoredFileName, @FileExtension, @MimeType,          @FileSizeBytes, @PhysicalPath, @Checksum, @UploadedBy);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewFileID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_InsertFolder]     @FolderName          NVARCHAR(255),     @ParentFolderID      INT,     @OrgUnitID           INT,     @TemplateID          INT,     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT,     @FolderDepth         TINYINT,     @PhysicalPath        NVARCHAR(500),     @InheritPermission   BIT,     @CreatedBy           INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO storage.Folder         (FolderName, ParentFolderID, OrgUnitID, TemplateID, ConfidentialityLevel,          FolderDepth, PhysicalPath, InheritPermission, CreatedBy)     VALUES         (@FolderName, @ParentFolderID, @OrgUnitID, @TemplateID, @ConfidentialityLevel,          @FolderDepth, @PhysicalPath, @InheritPermission, @CreatedBy);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewFolderID; END

CREATE   PROCEDURE storage.sp_InsertFolderTemplate     @TemplateCode   NVARCHAR(50),     @TemplateName   NVARCHAR(200),     @TargetType     NVARCHAR(50),     @Description    NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @OrgUnitID      INT           = NULL,     @CreatedBy      INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO storage.FolderTemplate         (TemplateCode, TemplateName, TargetType, Description, OrgUnitID, IsActive, CreatedBy, CreatedDate)     VALUES         (@TemplateCode, @TemplateName, @TargetType, @Description, @OrgUnitID, 1, @CreatedBy, GETDATE());      SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_InsertFolderTemplateItem]     @TemplateID          INT,     @ParentItemID        INT,     @FolderName          NVARCHAR(255),     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT,     @SortOrder           INT,     @InheritPermission   BIT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO storage.FolderTemplateItem         (TemplateID, ParentItemID, FolderName, ConfidentialityLevel, SortOrder, InheritPermission)     VALUES         (@TemplateID, @ParentItemID, @FolderName, @ConfidentialityLevel, @SortOrder, @InheritPermission);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewItemID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_PermanentDeleteFolder]     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     BEGIN TRANSACTION;     BEGIN TRY         WITH FolderCTE AS (             SELECT FolderID FROM storage.Folder WHERE FolderID = @FolderID             UNION ALL             SELECT f.FolderID FROM storage.Folder f             INNER JOIN FolderCTE cte ON f.ParentFolderID = cte.FolderID         )         UPDATE storage.FileDocument         SET    FileStatus = 3, DeletedDate = GETDATE()         WHERE  FolderID IN (SELECT FolderID FROM FolderCTE) AND FileStatus != 3;          WITH FolderCTE AS (             SELECT FolderID FROM storage.Folder WHERE FolderID = @FolderID             UNION ALL             SELECT f.FolderID FROM storage.Folder f             INNER JOIN FolderCTE cte ON f.ParentFolderID = cte.FolderID         )         DELETE FROM security.FolderPermission         WHERE  FolderID IN (SELECT FolderID FROM FolderCTE);          WITH FolderCTE AS (             SELECT FolderID FROM storage.Folder WHERE FolderID = @FolderID             UNION ALL             SELECT f.FolderID FROM storage.Folder f             INNER JOIN FolderCTE cte ON f.ParentFolderID = cte.FolderID         )         DELETE FROM storage.Folder         WHERE  FolderID IN (SELECT FolderID FROM FolderCTE);          COMMIT TRANSACTION;     END TRY     BEGIN CATCH         ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;         THROW;     END CATCH END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_RemoveQuickAccess]     @UserID   INT,     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DELETE FROM storage.QuickAccessFolder     WHERE UserID = @UserID AND FolderID = @FolderID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_RenameFileDocument]     @FileID           INT,     @OriginalFileName NVARCHAR(500) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      UPDATE storage.FileDocument     SET    OriginalFileName = @OriginalFileName     WHERE  FileID = @FileID       AND  DeletedDate IS NULL;   -- ไม่อนุญาตให้เปลี่ยนชื่อไฟล์ที่ถูกลบแล้ว END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_RestoreFolder]     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     WITH FolderCTE AS (         SELECT FolderID FROM storage.Folder WHERE FolderID = @FolderID         UNION ALL         SELECT f.FolderID FROM storage.Folder f         INNER  JOIN FolderCTE cte ON f.ParentFolderID = cte.FolderID     )     UPDATE storage.Folder     SET    IsDeleted = 0, DeletedBy = NULL, DeletedDate = NULL, RecycleBinExpiry = NULL     WHERE  FolderID IN (SELECT FolderID FROM FolderCTE); END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_SoftDeleteFileDocument]     @FileID    INT,     @DeletedBy INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.FileDocument     SET    FileStatus = 3, DeletedBy = @DeletedBy, DeletedDate = GETDATE()     WHERE  FileID = @FileID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_SoftDeleteFolder]     @FolderID  INT,     @DeletedBy INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     WITH FolderCTE AS (         SELECT FolderID FROM storage.Folder WHERE FolderID = @FolderID         UNION ALL         SELECT f.FolderID FROM storage.Folder f         INNER  JOIN FolderCTE cte ON f.ParentFolderID = cte.FolderID     )     UPDATE storage.Folder     SET    IsDeleted = 1, DeletedBy = @DeletedBy,            DeletedDate = GETDATE(), RecycleBinExpiry = DATEADD(DAY, 30, GETDATE())     WHERE  FolderID IN (SELECT FolderID FROM FolderCTE); END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateAllFolderFileCounts] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          DECLARE @UpdatedCount INT;          -- อัพเดท FileCount สำหรับทุกโฟลเดอร์     UPDATE f     SET FileCount = (         SELECT COUNT(*)         FROM storage.FileDocument fd         WHERE fd.FolderID = f.FolderID           AND fd.FileStatus != 3  -- ไม่นับไฟล์ที่ถูกลบ           AND fd.DeletedDate IS NULL     )     FROM storage.Folder f;          SET @UpdatedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;     PRINT 'Updated FileCount for ' + CAST(@UpdatedCount AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' folders.'; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateFileDocument]     @FileID       INT,     @FolderID     INT,     @PhysicalPath NVARCHAR(500),     @FileStatus   TINYINT,     @ArchivedBy   INT,     @ArchivedDate DATETIME,     @DeletedBy    INT,     @DeletedDate  DATETIME AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.FileDocument     SET    FolderID     = @FolderID,            PhysicalPath = @PhysicalPath,            FileStatus   = @FileStatus,            ArchivedBy   = @ArchivedBy,            ArchivedDate = @ArchivedDate,            DeletedBy    = @DeletedBy,            DeletedDate  = @DeletedDate     WHERE  FileID = @FileID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateFolder]     @FolderID             INT,     @FolderName           NVARCHAR(255),     @ParentFolderID       INT           = NULL,     @FolderDepth          INT           = NULL,     @PhysicalPath         NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT,     @InheritPermission    BIT,     @UpdatedBy            INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.Folder     SET    FolderName           = @FolderName,            ParentFolderID       = COALESCE(@ParentFolderID, ParentFolderID),            FolderDepth          = COALESCE(@FolderDepth,    FolderDepth),            PhysicalPath         = COALESCE(@PhysicalPath,   PhysicalPath),            ConfidentialityLevel = @ConfidentialityLevel,            InheritPermission    = @InheritPermission,            UpdatedBy            = @UpdatedBy,            UpdatedDate          = GETDATE()     WHERE  FolderID = @FolderID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateFolderFileCount]     @FolderID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- อัพเดท FileCount สำหรับโฟลเดอร์ที่ระบุ     UPDATE storage.Folder     SET FileCount = (         SELECT COUNT(*)         FROM storage.FileDocument fd         WHERE fd.FolderID = @FolderID           AND fd.FileStatus != 3  -- ไม่นับไฟล์ที่ถูกลบ (Status 3 = Deleted)           AND fd.DeletedDate IS NULL     )     WHERE FolderID = @FolderID;          PRINT 'Updated FileCount for FolderID: ' + CAST(@FolderID AS VARCHAR(10)); END

CREATE PROCEDURE storage.sp_UpdateFolderOrgUnit     @FolderID  INT,     @OrgUnitID INT,     @UpdatedBy INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.Folder     SET    OrgUnitID   = @OrgUnitID,            UpdatedBy   = @UpdatedBy,            UpdatedDate = GETDATE()     WHERE  FolderID = @FolderID; END

CREATE   PROCEDURE storage.sp_UpdateFolderTemplate     @TemplateID     INT,     @TemplateCode   NVARCHAR(50),     @TemplateName   NVARCHAR(200),     @TargetType     NVARCHAR(50),     @Description    NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,     @OrgUnitID      INT           = NULL,     @IsActive       BIT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.FolderTemplate     SET         TemplateCode  = @TemplateCode,         TemplateName  = @TemplateName,         TargetType    = @TargetType,         Description   = @Description,         OrgUnitID     = @OrgUnitID,         IsActive      = @IsActive     WHERE TemplateID = @TemplateID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateFolderTemplateItem]     @ItemID              INT,     @FolderName          NVARCHAR(200),     @ConfidentialityLevel TINYINT,     @SortOrder           INT,     @InheritPermission   BIT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.FolderTemplateItem     SET FolderName           = @FolderName,         ConfidentialityLevel = @ConfidentialityLevel,         SortOrder            = @SortOrder,         InheritPermission    = @InheritPermission     WHERE ItemID = @ItemID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [storage].[sp_UpdateVirusScanStatus]     @FileID          INT,     @VirusScanStatus TINYINT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE storage.FileDocument     SET    VirusScanStatus = @VirusScanStatus, VirusScanDate = GETDATE()     WHERE  FileID = @FileID; END

-- Create stored procedure for creating workflow instances CREATE PROCEDURE WFE.sp_CreateWFInstance     @WFDefinitionId INT,     @TemplateVersion INT,     @InitiatedBy NVARCHAR(255),     @InputParameters NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,     @NewWFInstanceId INT OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON     INSERT INTO WFE.t_WFInstance (WFDefinitionId, TemplateVersion, Status, InitiatedBy, InitiatedDate, InputParameters, IsDeleted)     VALUES (@WFDefinitionId, @TemplateVersion, 0, @InitiatedBy, GETUTCDATE(), @InputParameters, 0)      SET @NewWFInstanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY() END

CREATE PROCEDURE [WFE].[sp_CreateWFStepInstance]      @WFInstanceId INT = NULL,     @WFStepId INT = NULL,     @WorkflowInstanceId INT = NULL,     @WorkflowStepId INT = NULL,     @AssignedTo NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,     @SLADeadline DATETIME = NULL,     @NewWFStepInstanceId INT = NULL OUTPUT,     @NewWorkflowStepInstanceId INT = NULL OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      DECLARE @ResolvedWFInstanceId INT = COALESCE(@WFInstanceId, @WorkflowInstanceId);     DECLARE @ResolvedWFStepId INT = COALESCE(@WFStepId, @WorkflowStepId);     DECLARE @NewWorkflowId INT;      IF @ResolvedWFInstanceId IS NULL OR @ResolvedWFStepId IS NULL     BEGIN         RAISERROR('WFInstanceId and WFStepId are required.', 16, 1);         RETURN;     END;      IF @AssignedTo IS NULL OR @AssignedTo = ''     BEGIN         SELECT @AssignedTo = InitiatedBy FROM WFE.t_WFInstance WHERE WFInstanceId = @ResolvedWFInstanceId;     END;      IF @AssignedTo IS NULL OR @AssignedTo = ''         SET @AssignedTo = 'system';      BEGIN TRAN;      SELECT @NewWorkflowId = ISNULL(MAX(WorkflowStepInstanceId), 0) + 1     FROM WFE.t_WFStepInstance WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK);      INSERT INTO WFE.t_WFStepInstance         (WorkflowStepInstanceId, WFInstanceId, WFStepId, Status, AssignedTo, AssignedDate, StartedDate, SLADeadline, SLAStatus, IsDeleted)     VALUES         (@NewWorkflowId, @ResolvedWFInstanceId, @ResolvedWFStepId, 1, @AssignedTo, GETDATE(), GETDATE(),          CASE WHEN @SLADeadline IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), @SLADeadline, 126) END,          N'1', 0);      SET @NewWFStepInstanceId = CONVERT(INT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());  -- single call, not two     SET @NewWorkflowStepInstanceId = @NewWFStepInstanceId;      COMMIT; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE WFE.sp_UpdateWFInstanceStatus     @WFInstanceId INT = NULL,     @WorkflowInstanceId INT = NULL,     @Status TINYINT,     @CurrentStepId INT = NULL,     @CompletedDate DATETIME = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @ResolvedWFInstanceId INT = COALESCE(@WFInstanceId, @WorkflowInstanceId);      IF @ResolvedWFInstanceId IS NULL     BEGIN         RAISERROR('WFInstanceId is required.', 16, 1);         RETURN;     END;      UPDATE WFE.t_WFInstance     SET Status = @Status,         CurrentStepId = @CurrentStepId,         CompletedDate = @CompletedDate     WHERE WFInstanceId = @ResolvedWFInstanceId; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_GetAllApprovalSteps]     @RequestID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT StepID, RequestID, StepOrder, ApproverID, StepStatus,            ActionDate, ActionRemark, DelegatedTo, NotifiedDate, EscalatedDate     FROM   workflow.ApprovalStep     WHERE  RequestID = @RequestID     ORDER  BY StepOrder; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_GetApprovalRequestByID]     @RequestID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT RequestID, RequestType, FolderID, FileID, PermissionID, RequestedBy,            RequestedDate, RequestStatus, Subject, Remark, ExpiryDate,            ResolvedBy, ResolvedDate, ResolveRemark     FROM   workflow.ApprovalRequest     WHERE  RequestID = @RequestID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_GetExpiredPendingRequests] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT RequestID, RequestType, FolderID, FileID, PermissionID, RequestedBy,            RequestedDate, RequestStatus, Subject, Remark, ExpiryDate,            ResolvedBy, ResolvedDate, ResolveRemark     FROM   workflow.ApprovalRequest     WHERE  RequestStatus = 1 AND ExpiryDate < GETDATE(); END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_GetPendingApprovalSteps]     @RequestID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT StepID, RequestID, StepOrder, ApproverID, StepStatus,            ActionDate, ActionRemark, DelegatedTo, NotifiedDate, EscalatedDate     FROM   workflow.ApprovalStep     WHERE  RequestID = @RequestID AND StepStatus = 1     ORDER  BY StepOrder; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_GetPendingCreateHCRequests] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT RequestID, RequestType, FolderID, FileID, PermissionID, RequestedBy,            RequestedDate, RequestStatus, Subject, Remark, ExpiryDate,            ResolvedBy, ResolvedDate, ResolveRemark     FROM   workflow.ApprovalRequest     WHERE  RequestType = 'CREATE_HC' AND RequestStatus = 1     ORDER  BY RequestedDate DESC; END

-- ============================================================ -- workflow.ApprovalRequest / ApprovalStep -- ============================================================  CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_InsertApprovalRequest]     @RequestType  VARCHAR(50),     @FolderID     INT,     @FileID       INT,     @PermissionID INT,     @RequestedBy  INT,     @Subject      NVARCHAR(500),     @Remark       NVARCHAR(MAX),     @ExpiryDate   DATETIME AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO workflow.ApprovalRequest         (RequestType, FolderID, FileID, PermissionID, RequestedBy, Subject, Remark, ExpiryDate)     VALUES         (@RequestType, @FolderID, @FileID, @PermissionID, @RequestedBy, @Subject, @Remark, @ExpiryDate);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewRequestID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_InsertApprovalStep]     @RequestID  INT,     @StepOrder  INT,     @ApproverID INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     INSERT INTO workflow.ApprovalStep (RequestID, StepOrder, ApproverID)     VALUES (@RequestID, @StepOrder, @ApproverID);     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS NewStepID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_UpdateApprovalRequestStatus]     @RequestID     INT,     @RequestStatus TINYINT,     @ResolvedBy    INT,     @ResolveRemark NVARCHAR(500) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE workflow.ApprovalRequest     SET    RequestStatus = @RequestStatus,            ResolvedBy    = @ResolvedBy,            ResolvedDate  = GETDATE(),            ResolveRemark = @ResolveRemark     WHERE  RequestID = @RequestID; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [workflow].[sp_UpdateApprovalStepStatus]     @StepID       INT,     @StepStatus   TINYINT,     @ActionRemark NVARCHAR(500) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     UPDATE workflow.ApprovalStep     SET    StepStatus = @StepStatus, ActionDate = GETDATE(), ActionRemark = @ActionRemark     WHERE  StepID = @StepID; END
